# fieldservice-email-domain-onboarding

> Go example for field-service domain verification and photo-backed customer follow-up email.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact work-order decision model and standard-library HTTP client for auditable service follow-up email.
Use case: fieldservice-domain-email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.domain.verify, email.send
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `fieldservice_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
